Stakataka

Rock Steel

Alola · Generation 7

Stakataka is a Rock/Steel-type Rampart Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 5.5 m tall and weighs 820 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Defense (211), with a base stat total of 570.
